content.subject: Quick thought on ShipBob's expansion
content.draft_text:
Hi Alex,
ShipBob raised $200M, signaling significant rapid expansion financing. When a logistics platform scales quickly, intercompany reconciliation typically often becomes sprawling and error-prone. We build a system that automatically matches and posts intercompany transactions, removing manual spreadsheet work across departments for ops teams. Worth a 15-minute call next week?
